_meta.generated_by: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), reading every rule of out/rules.json and the corpus passages; no API call
_meta.key: <team_rule_id>:<sha256[:16] of json.dumps({title, requirement, interaction, coverage_conditions, exemptions, quoted_span, citation, category, jurisdiction, level}, sort_keys=True)>
_meta.evidence: each true flag (and construction_cutoff) needs evidence {doc_id, quote} or a list of them; every quote must be found verbatim (whitespace normalized, case-insensitive) in that corpus document. secondary_source evidence is {doc_id, manifest_source_type}, checked against the corpus manifests. Run python -m engine.precedence --verify.

fields.yields_to_local: state rule that gives way to a more protective local rule of the same category
fields.supersedes_state: local rule that replaces the state rule of the same category
fields.may_preempt_local: state law that may preempt local rules of the same category (conflict flag, human review)
fields.modifies_local: state law that exempts buildings from local rules of modifies_local_category; modifies_local_test on building facts, modifies_local_missing_fact when unknown
fields.bars_local_cap: forbids local caps without imposing one: a rule that applies, never a cap
fields.period_figure: valid_until ends a periodic figure, not a repeal
fields.amends_existing_law: the cited text amends an existing law; in_force_since is the date the provision has been in force when the corpus states it, else null
fields.event_only: only plays at an event (eviction, demolition, conversion, displacement)
fields.secondary_source: no official text in the corpus (manifest source_type)
fields.supersedes_same_level: explicit corpus passage: this rule replaces another rule of the same level whose citation contains one of supersedes_same_level_citations
fields.construction_cutoff: construction-date cutoff {covered_if: on_or_before | after, date} when the rule's structured coverage lacks it (complementary local ordinances, B2)
fields.date_conflict_note: participant-guide or source-reconciliation warning when published effective dates disagree; carried to lookup conflict_flag
